map.「评估抗MDA5(CADM-140)抗体阳性皮肌炎的临床特征及RP-ILD风险分: Performs professional calculation and outputs results based on input parameters for "assessing clinical features and RP-ILD risk stratification in anti-MDA5 (CADM-140) antibody-positive dermatomyositis".
map.📋 抗MDA5抗体 关键临床意义: 📋 Key Clinical Significance of Anti-MDA5 Antibody
map.：抗MDA5抗体是临床无肌病型皮肌炎合并间质性肺病的标志性抗体(阳性率50-70: : anti-MDA5 is a hallmark antibody of clinically amyopathic DM with ILD (positivity 50-70%)
map.：抗MDA5阳性患者RP-ILD发生率高达50-80%，6个月内死亡率40-60: : anti-MDA5-positive patients have 50-80% RP-ILD incidence, 40-60% mortality within 6 months (Asian population)
map.：MDA5阳性患者皮肤溃疡/穿孔发生率显著升高: : anti-MDA5-positive patients have significantly higher skin ulcer/perforation rates
map.：CK通常正常或轻度升高(区别于其他肌炎亚型): : CK usually normal or mildly elevated (vs other myositis subtypes)
map.：血清铁蛋白显著升高是RP-ILD预后不良的标志: : markedly elevated serum ferritin is a poor-prognosis marker for RP-ILD
map.MDA5+, 有ILD, 铁蛋白轻中度升高: MDA5+, ILD present, ferritin mildly-moderately elevated
map.激素+他克莫司/环磷酰胺，密切监测肺功能: Steroids + tacrolimus/cyclophosphamide, monitor pulmonary function closely
map.大剂量激素+环磷酰胺+JAK抑制剂，评估肺移植: High-dose steroids + cyclophosphamide + JAK inhibitor, assess lung transplant
map.强化免疫抑制+血浆置换+托珠单抗，ICU监护: Intensified immunosuppression + plasma exchange + tocilizumab, ICU care
map.提示：抗MDA5抗体阳性皮肌炎是风湿免疫科危重症之一，RP-ILD是主要死因。治: Note: anti-MDA5-positive dermatomyositis is one of the critical emergencies in rheumatology; RP-ILD is the main cause of death. Treatment emphasizes early recognition and intensified immunosuppression: high-dose glucocorticoids with calcineurin inhibitors (tacrolimus/cyclosporine) and cyclophosphamide. JAK inhibitors (tofacitinib/baricitinib) and anti-IL-6 receptor (tocilizumab) can be used for refractory RP-ILD. Dynamic serum ferritin monitoring is key for prognosis. For clinical reference only.
map.MDA5 阳性 + 临床无肌病型(CADM) + 快速进展性肺间质病变(rpIL: MDA5 positive + clinically amyopathic DM (CADM) + rapidly progressive ILD (rpILD) + skin ulcer/palmar papules + ferritin 1200 → high risk score, high fatal ILD risk, needs aggressive immunosuppression.
map.MDA5 阳性 + 典型皮疹但无 rpILD、CK 正常 → 中风险，密切随访肺: MDA5 positive + typical rash but no rpILD, CK normal → moderate risk, close pulmonary follow-up.
map.抗 MDA5 阳性尤其 CADM 易伴快速进展 ILD，短期内可致呼吸衰竭，是皮: Anti-MDA5 positive, especially CADM, readily accompanies rapidly progressive ILD, causing respiratory failure within a short time; the most critical DM subtype.
map.CADM 可肌酶正常但肺损伤重，CK 正常不除外高危，需以影像与铁蛋白判。: CADM may have normal muscle enzymes but severe lung injury; normal CK does not exclude high risk, judge by imaging and ferritin.
